title: Improving Cross-Problem Vehicle Routing with Locally Augmented Preferences and Representation Disentanglement
abstract: arXiv:2608.24859v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-task vehicle routing problem (VRP) solvers seek to handle multiple VRP variants within a single unified model, avoiding the need to train a separate model for every variant. In spite of recent progress, current approaches remain limited on two fronts. On the training side, reinforcement learning suffers from reward-scale disparities and shrinking advantage signals as policies improve, whereas preference optimization stagnates once sampled tours become near-identical and thus fundamentally limited by the quality of the policy's own generated solutions, leaving both paradigms with weak supervision as training progresses. On the architecture side, existing fully shared encoders entangle constraint-dependent representations across heterogeneous variants, which limits generalization. translated_title: 改进跨问题车辆路径规划：结合局部增强偏好与表示解缠
translated_abstract: 多任务车辆路径规划（VRP）求解器旨在通过一个统一模型处理多种VRP变体，避免为每种变体单独训练模型。尽管近期取得了进展，当前方法仍存在两个方面的局限性。在训练方面，强化学习面临奖励尺度差异和策略改进时优势信号萎缩的问题，而偏好优化在采样路线变得几乎相同后停滞不前，因此从根本上受限于策略自身生成解的质量，导致两种范式在训练后期都缺乏有效监督。在架构方面，现有的全共享编码器将异构变体间的约束相关表示纠缠在一起，限制了泛化能力。我们通过两项模型无关的贡献来解决这些差距。首先，我们提出了局部增强精炼偏好优化（POLAR），这是一种新颖的...（摘要截断）
tldr: 本文提出POLAR方法和表示解缠机制，解决多任务车辆路径规划中训练监督不足和架构表示纠缠的问题，提升跨问题泛化能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes POLAR and representation disentanglement to address weak supervision in training and entangled representations in architecture for multi-task vehicle routing, improving cross-problem generalization.
